title: Private Encrypted Artifact Storage and Scoped Retrieval Foundation
summary: KESPA implemented a private upload and artifact foundation with encrypted originals outside the public web root, chat/project/account scoping, owner-scoped metadata and indexing structures, and runtime-storage exclusion from Git. A live artifact was successfully stored as an encrypted .kespa blob with 600 permissions after two production upload failures were diagnosed and corrected; semantic cross-chat retrieval and enrichment remain outside the verified boundary of this checkpoint.
